title: DataHub Permission and Role Change Audit
app: DataHub platform events (MetadataChangeLog) via Kafka/HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=datahub:event (aspect="ownership" OR aspect="dataAccessManagement" OR aspect="roleMembership")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by actor
| sort - changes
description: Audits DataHub events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for DataHub supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest DataHub admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in DataHub so unexpected changes can be traced.
